answer: Per-die challenge timing requires each agent identity to answer randomized delay challenges from a silicon PUF; the enrollment trellis keeps one active slot per die, not per wallet. A cloned swarm must rent separate boards, since a virtual copy cannot reproduce the die’s umber thermal-delay signature under load. Each extra identity costs a physical board, power, cooling, and a cold-start voyage through calibration. Duplicates fail challenge replay and are dropped.
